scope.subject: New forced-response stability/clearance scan and finite-initialization/port-error work bound; final main and supplementary claim wording.
scope.independence: Read source and saved arrays directly. Independent mathematical derivation, finite differences, exact Fraction arithmetic, eigendecompositions and spectral residual calculations. Existing validation.json was not treated as proof.
scope.mutations: Only this independent_qa.json is created by the reviewer; colleagues code, results and TeX are not modified.
not_performed: No re-integration of the entire 1715-case scan.
No independent re-run of the long robust Radau trajectories or full startup sweeps.
No independent Arb inversion/LDL re-run in this reviewer process; the default Python lacked flint. Exact rational initialization and outward-export comparisons were independently run.
No independent recompilation of the final manuscript and supplement; this QA is not a new full-paper mathematical certification.
scope.execution_method: Python code evaluated from PowerShell standard input. Selected functions parsed with ast and executed without numba decorators, avoiding cache writes. No uploaded manuscript or external write.

variational_and_physical_rhs.method: For n=2,8,64, canonical states and normalized perturbation vectors generated with numpy default_rng seed 711; central difference step 1e-6, t=0.3 s, A=0.004 T, frequency ratio 0.97. Compare analytic variational RHS to directional finite differences, and modal acceleration to independently projected raw nodal M,K dynamics.
variational_and_physical_rhs.interpretation: Checks signs, SI time scaling and the derivative 1-cos(theta)-u*sin(theta). Numerical checks, not a proof of the integration error.

spatial_bernstein.method: Independently evaluate cubic Hermite displacement and quadratic spatial derivative at 101 points per element for the sampled states; compare against exported Bernstein control bounds.
spatial_bernstein.analytical_scope: Cubic rows w0,w0+l*theta0/3,w1-l*theta1/3,w1 and quadratic slope rows theta0,3*(w1-w0)/l-theta0-theta1,theta1 correctly bound the FE element in space. Sampling these bounds in time is not a continuous-time enclosure.

zero_forcing_floquet.method: Independently execute the two-mode monodromy helper for one period at zero forcing and zero state, 256 steps per period; compare all multipliers with exp((-alpha/2 +/- i*sqrt(omega_j^2-alpha^2/4))*T).

stored_floquet_eigendecomposition.method: Independently call numpy.linalg.eigvals on each saved 4x4 monodromy matrix; compare spectral radii to saved metadata. This does not re-integrate the orbits.
stored_floquet_eigendecomposition.scope: Numerical local stability of the tested two-mode forced periodic responses, with forcing phase fixed; not a full 64-mode Floquet certificate or a global parameter-space theorem.

fourier_nonlinear_residual.original_issue: The original residual reused the nonlinear force that generated the transfer-function response. It therefore mainly tested the linear transfer identity and could miss mismatch between the iterated angle and d@x.
fourier_nonlinear_residual.correction: verify_and_boundaries.py lines 131-135 reconstruct theta=d@x, recompute theta-sin(theta)+u*cos(theta), and check both first-order equations.
fourier_nonlinear_residual.independent_method: For all 31 saved 1024-phase, 64-mode crossing waveforms, independently rFFT the saved x,y, differentiate spectrally, and evaluate the complete nonlinear RHS at d@x.

exact_metadata_reproduction.method: Execute the corrected periodic_response function at all 31 saved amplitude/ratio pairs.

different_derivative_routes_explained.builtin: Derivative from the retained Fourier transfer coefficients, without a time-to-spectrum round trip.
different_derivative_routes_explained.independent_saved_state: Derivative after inverse FFT state storage and a new forward FFT; small round-trip errors are amplified by spectral differentiation.
different_derivative_routes_explained.interpretation: The larger independent number is from a different floating-point differentiation route, not inconsistent state data or metadata. Both are numerical checks, not interval enclosures.

fourier_nonlinear_residual.scope: The independent saved-state calculation also found a small nonlinear residual before the reporting fix; the issue affected the diagnostic definition, not the saved orbit values.

exact_initialization_64d.method: Use standard-library Fraction.from_float for every frozen binary M,K,Phi, saved modal initial component and frozen nodal reference component. Form q=Phi*a0 and v=Phi*v0 by exact rational products; add exact decimal E0=6e-7 to the last K diagonal. Evaluate the full 64-dimensional Q without floating-point summation.
exact_initialization_64d.root_free_exact_enclosure_test: Let s = Fraction(exported_Ebar)-Q_reference-5e-12. Check s>=0 and s*s>=4*Q_reference*5e-12 exactly, proving Ebar >= (sqrt(Q_reference)+sqrt(5e-12))^2.
exact_initialization_64d.scope: Exact for the declared frozen dyadic nodal matrices/reference and saved initial modal values; no claim of exact-torus membership or continuum-beam certification.

outward_export.method: At Decimal precision 110 compare exact binary64 exports with both endpoints of the printed high-precision Arb ball strings; verify upper exports exceed upper endpoints and lower exports are below lower endpoints.
outward_export.implementation: run_operational_tolerances.py lines 49-50 applies np.nextafter after ball-to-float conversion.
outward_export.limitation: This checks the exported endpoint direction and code; it is not a fresh independent calculation of every inverse-matrix Arb ball.

mathematical_review.robust_power_envelope: Passed: Delta_B=mu*(delta_omega+abs(omega_hat)*delta_theta) follows from cosine being 1-Lipschitz. Multiplicative errors enter Pplus homogeneously, so Pplus(0)=0.
mathematical_review.additive_error_separation: Passed: additive execution errors are bounded together with damping by p_e=(epsilon_F*sqrt(m_F)+mu*epsilon_B*sqrt(m_theta))^2/(4*alpha), and use R_T=T*p_e. Zero commanded input is not assumed to remove additive disturbances.
mathematical_review.governor_invariance: Passed: positive homogeneity gives Wdot<=kappa*(C-W), W(0)<C; E(t)<=W(t)+t*p_e<=Emax for 0<=t<=T. With constant nonzero additive allowance this is finite horizon, not all time.
mathematical_review.actuator_limits: Passed after correction: clip commands at (actual_limit-epsilon)/(1+eta) before radial scaling. Actual force/field limits then follow from the stated envelope.
mathematical_review.spatial_continuous_time_clearance: Passed conditionally: instantaneous FE Bernstein/compliance estimate and the analytic all-times energy inequality, not temporal sampling of simulation maxima, give the continuous-time 4 s clearance bound.
mathematical_review.initialization: Passed: a full-state Q error ellipsoid around a finite exported reference; projected tip/angle/RMS error bounds are not an independently selectable Cartesian box.
mathematical_review.sampling_and_delay: Passed as conditional sufficient rules: sensor age inflation needs verified rate/acceleration bounds; h_k*Pplus_k<=C-W_k bounds within-interval work. Execution delay uses a separately verified slew/error budget. No measured hardware latency is asserted.
mathematical_review.frozen_model_scope: The robust proof is for exact exported nodal matrices. The text acknowledges their small diagonalization discrepancy from the frozen modal model used in the ideal KAM result.
mathematical_review.finite_time_lyapunov: One tangent-vector renormalization supplies a conditional finite-time growth estimate at fixed forcing phase; it is not an exact largest-singular-value finite-time exponent or a global absence-of-chaos proof.

resolved_findings.resolution: Explicit nextafter outward conversion; independently checked relevant ball/export endpoints.

resolved_findings.resolution: Output renamed tip_slope_bound_rad; theorem whole-centreline bound uses displacement Bernstein rows.

Initialized error should be measured about the frozen exact dyadic nodal reference, including modal-to-nodal reconstruction.
resolved_findings.resolution: Arb check in source and independent exact 64D Fraction check pass.

resolved_findings.issue: Fourier ODE residual reused the forcing used to construct the orbit.
resolved_findings.resolution: Recompute from reconstructed theta and check both first-order equations; all saved cases independently checked.

resolved_findings.resolution: Final operational_tolerances.tex line 285 now states <3.2e-15 J.

claim_wording_review.core_application_lines_84_86: Pass: identifies the 1715 two-mode scan, numerical Floquet results, no detected transition under the sampled protocol, 64-mode numerical steady crossings, and possible startup overshoot.
claim_wording_review.core_application_lines_110_112: Pass: distinguishes finite initialization from tiny KAM action tube; states a 4 s clearance guarantee under full-state and port-error hypotheses; does not promise noisy exact-torus persistence or tracking accuracy.
claim_wording_review.stability_boundary_lines_70_100: Pass: distinguishes numerical sampled-point stability from a continuous parameter theorem and conservative KAM breakup; spatial Bernstein bounds explicitly refer to sampled phases.
claim_wording_review.stability_boundary_lines_104_147: Pass: full-FE steady versus eight-mode startup contours are protocol dependent and not certified safe-field limits; 32-period full-FE startup crosschecks are not presented as proven infinite-time roots.
claim_wording_review.operational_tolerances_lines_269_289: Pass: trajectory peaks are labelled saved-time results; analytic clearance and ideal invariant-torus results are separate; tolerance refinement is an implementation check, not a validated trajectory enclosure.

numerical_scope_reminders: Only two-mode periodic responses have the full 1715-case Floquet calculation. Full 64-mode periodic branches have separate Fourier/Radau agreement checks.
A spatial upper bound above 4 mm alone does not prove actual violation; at the reported steady roots it equals the sampled actual tip maximum. Startup examples separately show actual tip overshoot.
A finite phase grid can shift numerical crossing estimates. The reported phase/mode/time refinements quantify selected discrepancies but are not rigorous global error bars.
The 0.1 rad slope screen is a reporting convention, not a calibrated material/model-validity threshold.
The work governor substantially changes the requested motion (active at about 97.8 percent of saved robust-run times); the proved new capability is bounded-error clearance, not exact KAM tracking.
No contact model or new hardware validation is supplied by these numerical additions.
